name: create_factorial
description: Creates a C program that computes factorial
prompts: Create a C program for factorial in a file called factorial.c. The program should read a single integer from stdin and print its factorial (just the number, on its own line).

test_setup_files.test_factorial.py:
import subprocess
subprocess.run(['gcc', 'factorial.c', '-o', 'factorial_bin'], check=True)
cases = [(0, 1), (1, 1), (5, 120), (10, 3628800)]
for n, expected in cases:
    out = subprocess.run(['./factorial_bin'], input=f'{n}\n', capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5).stdout
    assert str(expected) in out, f'factorial({n}): expected {expected} in output, got {out!r}'
print('PASS')
